name: config-watch
description: Watches the ACTIVE workbench config file and applies an EXTERNAL edit to the running process live (reconcile), with debounce, atomic-rename handling, self-write suppression and structured state

debounceMs.description: Coalescing window for filesystem events, milliseconds

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum delay between two applies (rate limit / churn guard)

pollMs.description: Optional polling fallback in milliseconds (0 = off); only for filesystems without inotify

retryDelayMs.description: Delay between the read retries of an atomic-write window

readRetries.description: How many times a read is retried before it is reported as an error

recentLimit.description: Size of the event ring buffer exposed in the state

file.description: Watch a different file (default: the config file the host actually loaded)
